correctness.rationale: Every 3-list assignment on six labelled vertices is uniquely encoded up to color renaming by 63 nonempty support multiplicities with per-vertex sum 3; the complete exact enumerator visits 2,406,208 such encodings independently confirmed by support DP. For each encoding and each of four maximal degree-two graphs, full backtracking never rejects a potentially valid solution (adjacency conflict, upper quota, or infeasible lower quota only) and finds a proper assignment satisfying all 3-list proportional quotas; 9,624,832 graph-assignment pairs pass. Every order-six graph of maximum degree two is a subgraph of one of those maxima, and monotonicity extends to all smaller orders. The exact choice number corollary invokes the proven published 2-list classification and the elementary 1-list characterization. This is a finite exhaustive proof with complete checker source, not an infinite sample extrapolation.

It does not claim the general conjecture or automatic independent certification.
